motion_alignment_score.definition: single-branch candidate-blind visual structure aligned with the native action

response_consistency_score.definition: same-source intervention difference in video aligned with intervention difference in action

grounding_score.definition: generated visual future and native action grounded against an external logged or simulated future
grounding_score.current_status: implemented as tentative wrapper; not a replacement for FCS

causal_boundary: MAS/RCS establish consistency or response matching; neither alone proves future-to-action mediation.
